About the HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride group ride

Fast Sunday shop ride out of HB Velo, 25 to 70 miles at about 18 mph. The Wednesday and Friday coffee rides are the easier option at 15 mph and about 25 miles. Ride updates are posted on the shop's Facebook page.
